draft_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on all six datasets in the tabular suite.
revised_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on five of the six datasets in the tabular suite, with Arbor-GBT higher on Ivel-Fraud.
rationale: T1 shows Ferrule higher on r1 (81.6>80.9), r2 (88.3>87.1), r4 (76.4>75.6), r5 (84.9>84.1), r6 (90.2>89.0), but lower on r3 Ivel-Fraud (92.3<92.8). So "all six" is unsupported; five of six is correct.
